parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 1 in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Histone deacetylase 1' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
